cards.name: Persistent field actor
cards.mechanism: Represent long-lived spatial techniques such as Blue/Red/Purple as world actors owning lifecycle, area effects and animation.

cards.name: Central defense/counter predicate
cards.mechanism: Infinity bypasses converge through AntiInfinityProcedure instead of being duplicated across attacks.

cards.name: Shared domain state machine
cards.mechanism: Common barrier/lifecycle/battle state with character-specific domain payload.

cards.name: Per-source adaptation ledger
cards.mechanism: Persist adaptation progress keyed by incoming damage identity and use progress to change damage semantics.

cards.name: Generic attack resolver escalation
cards.mechanism: Common RangeAttack pipeline can probabilistically escalate a valid hit into Black Flash according to combat state.

cards.name: Capability-backed combat state
cards.mechanism: Synchronized player capability stores curse energy, technique selection, progression and combat flags.

cards.name: Tag-driven combat eligibility
cards.mechanism: Entity tags define access to RCT/domain counters/technique capabilities.

cards.name: Explicit anti-domain verbs
cards.mechanism: Simple Domain, Domain Amplification and Hollow Wicker Basket remain semantically distinct counters.

cards.name: Dual animation transport
cards.mechanism: PlayerAnimator networked player animations and GeckoLib entity animations are separate execution paths.

cards.name: Procedure-graph-first analysis
cards.mechanism: Generated projects require shared-helper/call-graph mapping before class-name interpretation.

cards.name: Parameterized world destruction
cards.mechanism: Area techniques carry Range/Knockback/BlockRange/BlockDamage/ExtinctionBlock as explicit effect state.
